title: Build a component in the library from its design, approved in Figma
prompt: The Command component's design is approved in Figma: node 4:568 in the file "Design fence landing" (file key {{key}}). Build it in the component library, as the element df-command (a command or a program's output in the monospace font, with an optional copy button), with its stories in Storybook. Change nothing in Figma. Work on your own to the end: do not ask questions, and do not commit. When it is ready to commit, stop and tell me what you built and what you checked.
